category: Protect All Forms of Code from Unauthorized Access and Tampering (PS)
subcategory_text: Provide a mechanism to verify the integrity of code (e.g., cryptographic hashes, digital signatures) and reject code whose integrity cannot be verified.
implementation_examples: Sign release artefacts with a hardened signing key
Verify the signature on every artefact before deployment
Reject unsigned or unverified artefacts in deployment pipelines
assessment_objectives: Determine whether code artefacts are integrity-protected (signature or hash).
Determine whether unverified code is rejected by the deployment pipeline.
